name: FastAPI
description: A modern, fast web framework for building APIs with Python.
summary: Contributors are encouraged to use any tools, including AI, as long as there is meaningful human judgement and effort; PRs that cost more to review than to prompt should not be sent. PRs that look AI-generated or automated are closed, and LLM-generated comments and descriptions should not be pasted.

evidence.quote: You are encouraged to use all the tools you want to do your work and contribute as efficiently as possible, this includes AI (LLM) tools, etc. Nevertheless, contributions should have meaningful human intervention, judgement, context, etc.
If the human effort put in a PR, e.g. writing LLM prompts, is less than the effort we would need to put to review it, please don't submit the PR.
The same applies to comments and descriptions, please don't copy-paste the content generated by an LLM.
